meta.source: hvwingiv-svg/CritterSitter design/tokens.json (the app reads these via src/tokens.css)

tokens.name: cs-app-bg
tokens.usage: Dark backdrop behind the card frame and the top navigation bar.

tokens.name: cs-card
tokens.usage: The main card surface every screen sits on.

tokens.name: cs-surface
tokens.usage: Fields, rows, tiles and buttons that sit on cs-card.

tokens.name: cs-surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Input and section fills slightly off cs-surface.

tokens.name: cs-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary pill buttons (Back) and muted chips.

tokens.name: cs-line
tokens.usage: Default 1px borders and dividers on cs-card.

tokens.name: cs-line-strong
tokens.usage: Dashed and emphasized borders (add-vaccine, empty states).

tokens.name: cs-ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on cs-card and cs-surface.

tokens.name: cs-ink-2
tokens.usage: Field values and row labels.

tokens.name: cs-ink-3
tokens.usage: Section headers inside accordions.

tokens.name: cs-ink-4
tokens.usage: Secondary labels.

tokens.name: cs-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles and helper text.

tokens.name: cs-ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholder-strength text and chevrons.

tokens.name: cs-chrome-text
tokens.usage: Screen name and icons in the top bar on cs-app-bg.

tokens.name: cs-chrome-text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on cs-app-bg.

tokens.name: cs-chrome-muted
tokens.usage: Muted labels on cs-app-bg.

tokens.name: cs-chrome-surface
tokens.usage: Round Back button in the top bar.

tokens.name: cs-camera-bg
tokens.usage: Background of the in-app camera viewfinder.

tokens.name: cs-camera-surface
tokens.usage: Camera viewfinder panels.

tokens.name: cs-camera-control
tokens.usage: Camera buttons such as flip and close.

tokens.name: cs-scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed overlay behind bottom sheets (used at 45%).

tokens.name: cs-accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, Next arrows, paw circles, selected states.

tokens.name: cs-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of cs-accent.

tokens.name: cs-on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cs-accent.

tokens.name: cs-danger
tokens.usage: LOST PET heading, flyer border, remove badges.

tokens.name: cs-danger-line
tokens.usage: Borders of danger fields (Last seen near).

tokens.name: cs-danger-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of danger fields.

tokens.name: cs-danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside danger fields.

tokens.name: cs-danger-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of cs-danger buttons.

tokens.name: cs-danger-soft

tokens.name: cs-warning-line
tokens.usage: Do-not-chase banner border.

tokens.name: cs-warning-ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text inside the amber callouts.

tokens.name: cs-warning-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Helper text inside the amber callouts.

styles.name: code
